title: API Performance Validation
description: Measure approved API scenarios under bounded load against customer-defined latency, throughput, error, and capacity policies.
setup_prompt: Use API Performance Validation for my authorized service environment. Preserve the exact target, authentication, scenarios, load limits, and budgets; run a bounded repeatable profile; retain sanitized measurements and diagnostics; and report regressions without changing policy.

setup_inputs.label: Authorized API/service environment and exact build
Endpoints, protocols, payload classes, and functional expectations
Authentication, test identities, and secret references
Rate, concurrency, duration, connection, and stop limits
Metrics, thresholds or baseline, and decision policy
Optional metrics, logs, and traces access

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks scripted execution
recommended_tools.purpose: Run the saved API workload and deterministic result processing under the workflow contract

recommended_tools.name: Customer-selected load-test CLI
recommended_tools.purpose: Generate the approved rate or concurrency profile with machine-readable results

recommended_tools.name: Observability MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Correlate authorized service metrics, logs, or traces with a performance run

pulse_focus.label: Technical review
focus_areas: Load profile execution, sample validity, and error classification
Latency, throughput, capacity, and budget calculations
review_when: A run fails, produces incomplete evidence, or a key metric becomes unreliable

pulse_focus.label: Architecture review
focus_areas: Scenario design, traffic isolation, data setup, and result storage
review_when: The workflow, integration, environment, scale, or operating policy changes materially

pulse_focus.label: Strategic review
focus_areas: Whether scenarios represent production demand and customer impact
Capacity risk, performance policy, and testing cost
review_when: Outcome metrics regress, priorities change, or the current approach needs periodic challenge

outputs: Versioned API performance policy and load profile
Latency, throughput, error, and budget decisions
